name: Eat Drywall
desc:
Welcome to Eat Drywall
In this game you eat drywall

Have fun with your friends, meet new people, and unlock fun tools and gadgets as you eat
There are also various secrets and badges you can try to get

Credits to DM DOKURO for some of the music. Credits to flaticon for some of the UI icons. Credits to Q_Moth for some of the models and vfx.
